children: Alexandria Real Estate Equities entered into an Escrow Agreement on July 9, 2026 to facilitate a planned fourth amended and restated credit agreement. The arrangement involves Citibank as administrative agent, certain lenders, and O'Melveny & Myers as escrow agent. The escrow structure is intended to coordinate execution and closing logistics for the forthcoming amended facility, supporting the company’s financing flexibility.
: Escrow agreement related to fourth amended and restated credit agreement
: Citibank, as Administrative Agent; O'Melveny & Myers, as Escrow Agent; and certain lenders
: Facilitate execution of amended credit facility
